findings.title: Include the sourced extension from division to midpoint and incompleteness
findings.details: The inspected 字源 entry proposes that 半’s “middle” and “incomplete” senses extend from dividing an object. The authored article omits this positive proposal and instead leaves those paths unresolved throughout its history and sense records. Add the cited proposal while preserving its disagreement with the competing account that “half” was original; do not imply that the proposal establishes a dated sequence.
findings.verification: Revise the affected history or meaning_history and midpoint and partial sense records to include the 字源 proposal with its evidence ID. Obtain fresh factual and readability reviews for the changed article, and confirm the generated sense relationships agree with the revised account.
